```{r}

monitors_all <- list(mon_3_1, mon_4_1, mon_5_1, mon_6_1, mon_16_1, mon_17_1, mon_18_1, 
                     mon_16_2, mon_17_2, mon_18_2,
                     mon_16_3, mon_17_3, mon_18_3, mon_19_3, mon_20_3)

monitor_ids_all <- c("3_1", "4_1", "5_1", "6_1", "16_1", "17_1", "18_1", 
                     "16_2", "17_2", "18_2",
                     "16_3", "17_3", "18_3", "19_3","20_3")

condition_map <- c("1" = "WT", "3" = "D1E Het", "4" = "D1E Homo", "5" = "P-L Homo", "6" = "P-L Het")

# Update the Condition column across the list of data frames
monitors_all <- lapply(monitors_all, function(df) {
  df$Condition <- sapply(df$Condition, function(cond) {
    parts <- strsplit(cond, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    new_prefix <- condition_map[parts[1]]
    paste(new_prefix, parts[-1], collapse = " ")
  })
  df
})

condition_seperator <- function(monitors, monitor_ids){
  
  # Create condition lists dynamically
  monitor_list <- setNames(lapply(monitors, function(mon) split(mon, mon$Condition)), monitor_ids)
  
  # Flatten condition lists into a named list
  all_conditions <- list()
  for (monitor_id in names(monitor_list)) {
    cond_list <- monitor_list[[monitor_id]]
    all_conditions <- c(all_conditions, setNames(cond_list, paste0("mon_", monitor_id, "_", names(cond_list))))
  }
  return(all_conditions)
}

all_conditions <- condition_seperator(monitors_all, monitor_ids_all)
```

```{r}
# Initialize an empty list to store dataframes by condition
condition_groups <- list()

# Iterate over all dataframes
for (df_name in names(all_conditions)) {
  # Extract condition from the dataframe name (last part after the last underscore)
  condition <- sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_(.*)$", "\\1", df_name)
  
  # Add dataframe to the appropriate condition list
  condition_groups[[condition]] <- c(condition_groups[[condition]], list(all_conditions[[df_name]]))
}
```

```{r}

# Initialize an empty list to store merged dataframes
merged_conditions <- list()

# Iterate over each condition group and merge dataframes
for (condition in names(condition_groups)) {
  
  df_list <- condition_groups[[condition]]  # Get list of dataframes for the condition
  
  # Use reduce with full_join to merge all dataframes in the group
  comb <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("Dec_time", "Dec_ZT_time", "Condition")), df_list)
  
  # Apply transformation to compute mean and SEM
  merged_df <- comb %>%
    mutate(mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("mean")), na.rm = TRUE),
           SEM = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("SEM")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select(Dec_time, Dec_ZT_time, Condition, mean, SEM)  # Keep only necessary columns
  
  # Store the merged dataframe in a named list
  merged_conditions[[paste0(condition, "_merged")]] <- merged_df
}

# `merged_conditions` now contains merged dataframes for each condition

```

```{r}
# Initialize an empty list to store dataframes by condition and gender
condition_groups <- list()

# Iterate over all dataframes
for (df_name in names(all_conditions)) {
  # Extract components from the dataframe name
  name_parts <- strsplit(df_name, "_")[[1]]
  condition <- strsplit(name_parts[4], " ")[[1]][1] # Condition number
  gender <- sub(".* ", "", df_name)  # Extract gender (after last space)
  
  # Create a unique key for grouping
  group_key <- paste(condition, gender, sep = "_")
  
  # Add dataframe to the appropriate group
  condition_groups[[group_key]] <- c(condition_groups[[group_key]], list(all_conditions[[df_name]]))
}

# Initialize an empty list to store merged dataframes
merged_conditions <- list()

# Iterate over each group and merge dataframes
for (group_key in names(condition_groups)) {
  df_list <- condition_groups[[group_key]]  # Get list of dataframes for the group
  
  # Use reduce with full_join to merge all dataframes in the group
  comb <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("Dec_time", "Dec_ZT_time", "Condition")), df_list)
  
  # Apply transformation to compute mean and SEM
  merged_df <- comb %>%
    mutate(mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("mean")), na.rm = TRUE),
           SEM = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("SEM")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select(Dec_time, Dec_ZT_time, Condition, mean, SEM)  # Keep only necessary columns
  
  # Store the merged dataframe with a meaningful name
  merged_conditions[[paste0(group_key, "_merged")]] <- merged_df
}

# `merged_conditions` now contains merged dataframes for each condition and gender
```

```{r}
binning <- function(df){
  activity_per_condition <- df
  act_profile_window <- 30
  data_recording_frequency <- 1
  
  # Calculating vectors of average values over X min non overlapping windows
  mean_of_activity_per_condition_30_min <- rollapply(activity_per_condition$mean, width = as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency), by = as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency), FUN = mean)
  
  sem_of_activity_per_condition_30_min <- rollapply(activity_per_condition$SEM, width = as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency), by = as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency), FUN = mean)
  
  activity_per_condition_1 <- {
    d <- data.frame(activity_per_condition, 
                    binned_mean = round(rep(mean_of_activity_per_condition_30_min, each=as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency)), 10),
                    binned_sem = round(rep(sem_of_activity_per_condition_30_min, each=as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency))), 10)
    d
  }
  
  # Sampling the data frame for every Xth row
  activity_30min_mean_2 <- activity_per_condition_1[seq(1, nrow(activity_per_condition_1), by = as.numeric(act_profile_window)/as.numeric(data_recording_frequency)),]
  
  #Drops unnecessary columns containing not averaged mean and SEM data
  activity_30min_mean <- select(activity_30min_mean_2, Dec_time, Dec_ZT_time, shifted_time, Condition, binned_mean, binned_sem)
  activity_30min_mean$binned_mean <-  30*activity_30min_mean$binned_mean
  
  return(activity_30min_mean)
}
```

```{r}
plot_activity <- function(d, title_, lull_period, shift){
  brakes_vector <- c((0+shift) %% 1440, (360+shift) %% 1440, (480+shift) %% 1440, (720+shift) %% 1440, (1080+shift) %% 1440, (1200+shift) %% 1440)
  
  vlines <- c((360+shift) %% 1440, lull_period[1], lull_period[2], (1320+shift) %% 1440)
  
  ac_profile_max_y <- 65
  colors <- c("#E0CB02", "#21918c", "#000000", "#BBBBBB")
  display_error_bars <- FALSE
  
  p<- plots_activity_30_min <-  ggplot(d, aes(shifted_time, y=binned_mean, ymax=3, ymin=0, colour=Condition)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.5)+
    #geom_point(color = "black", size = 0.6)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines)+
    labs(title= title_, x= "Time of the day [H]",
         y = "Average counts per 30 min")+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = brakes_vector, labels=c("0", "6", "8", "12", "18", "20"))+
    theme_bw()+
    scale_colour_manual(values=colors)+
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=10))+
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=14))+
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20))+
    theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=20))+
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size=18))+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20, hjust=-0.3, face="bold"))+
    guides(color = "none")+
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=1)))+ (   #edits the point size in a legend
      if (display_error_bars == "Yes")(
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymax=30*(binned_mean + binned_sem),ymin=30*(binned_mean - binned_sem)), width=0.3)
      ))+
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1440), ylim = c(0, ac_profile_max_y), expand = FALSE)
  
  # Define the AP phase data as a simple data frame
  ap_df <- data.frame(
    xmin = c(vlines[1], vlines[2], vlines[3], vlines[4]),
    xmax = c(vlines[2], vlines[3], vlines[4], 1440),
    label = c("AP1", "AP3", "AP2", "Inactive")
  )
  
  # Create the top annotation strip
  ap_plot <- ggplot(ap_df) +
    # Draw rectangles for each AP phase over the full vertical range (0 to 1)
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 0.1, fill = label), alpha = 0.3) +
    # Place the text labels at the center of each rectangle
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.05, label = label), size = 4) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1440), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +                      # Remove axes and background
    theme(legend.position = "none")+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("AP1" = "white", "AP2" = "white", "AP3" = "grey60", "Inactive" = "gray60"))
  
  
  # Define the light phase data
  lights_df <- data.frame(
    xmin = c(0, (480+shift) %% 1440, (1200+shift) %% 1440),
    xmax = c((480+shift) %% 1440, (1200+shift) %% 1440, 1400),
    label = c("", "Lights on", "Lights off")
  )
  
  # Create the bottom annotation strip
  lights_plot <- ggplot(lights_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = label), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.5, label = label), size = 4) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1440), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  combined_plot <- (
    ap_plot /
      p /
      lights_plot
  ) +
    plot_layout(
      ncol = 1,
      heights = c(0.1, 1, 0.1)  # top strip = 0.1, main = 1, bottom = 0.1
    ) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "My Overall Title for the Figure",  # choose your desired text
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
      )
    )
  
  print(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r}
# Define the breakpoints
lull_period <- list((c(630, 870)+shift) %% 1440, (c(720, 960)+shift) %% 1440, (c(630, 870)+shift) %% 1440, (c(720, 960)+shift) %% 1440)

#breaks <- c((360+shift) %% 1440, (630+shift) %% 1440, (870+shift) %% 1440, (1320+shift) %% 1440, 1440)

sliced_lists <- Map(function(df, k) {
  breaks <- c((360 + shift) %% 1440, lull_period[[k]], (1320 + shift) %% 1440, 1440)
  lapply(1:4, function(i) {
    df[df$shifted_time >= breaks[i] & df$shifted_time < breaks[i + 1], ]
  })
}, analysis_list, seq_along(analysis_list))
```

```{r}
# A small helper function to compute mean ± standard error
mean_se <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)
  se <- sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
  data.frame(y = m, ymin = m - se, ymax = m + se)
}

plot_list <- list()

colors <- c("#E0CB02", "#21918c", "#000000", "#BBBBBB")

for(i in seq_along(sliced_lists)) {
  
  # Combine the 5 data frames into one, tagging each row with its AP index
  df_combined <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sliced_lists[[i]]), function(j) {
    tmp <- sliced_lists[[i]][[j]]
    tmp$AP <- paste0("AP", j)  # e.g. "AP1", "AP2", ...
    tmp
  }))
  
  p <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = AP, y = mean, fill = Condition)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge()) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) +
    labs(title = paste("Mean Activity Periods for", title_list[i]),
         x = "Activity Period", y = "Mean Activity") +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
    theme_minimal()+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("AP 1", "AP 2", "AP 3", "Inactive"))
  
  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}
```

# Semimanual brackets
```{r}
bracket_helper <- function(x_left, y, star, double = F, size = 6){
  
  y_bracket <- y - 0.04
  y_ano <- y + 0.03
  
  if (double == T){
    x_right <- x_left + 0.6
    x_ano <- x_left + 0.3
  }
  else {
    x_right <- x_left + 0.3
    x_ano <- x_left + 0.15
  }
  
  list(
    # Horizontal bracket line
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_left, y = y, xend = x_right, yend = y)),
    # Vertical ticks on each end
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_left, y = y, xend = x_left, yend = y_bracket)),
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_right, y = y, xend = x_right, yend = y_bracket)),
    # Significance annotation (you probably meant to use `x_ano` and `y_ano` here)
    annotate("text", x = x_ano, y = y_ano, label = star, size = size)
  )
}
```

```{r}
bar_plot <- function(i){
  p <- ggplot(condition_sliced_list[[i]], aes(x = AP, y = mean, fill = Condition)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
                 position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), width = 0.2) +
    labs(title = paste("Mean Activity Periods for", title_list[i]),
         x = "Activity Period", y = "Mean Activity") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14))+
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.25))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("AP 1", "AP 2", "AP 3", "Inactive"))
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
  bracket_helper(3.7, 0.35, "***")+
  bracket_helper(4, 0.4, "***")+
  bracket_helper(3.7, 0.5, "***", T)

```

# Stats
```{r warning=FALSE}
ap_names <- c("AP 1", "AP 2", "AP 3", "Inactive")
pair_names <- c("Homo vs Het", "WT vs Het", "WT vs Homo")
homo_het_p <- list()
wt_het_p <- list()
wt_homo_p <- list()

condition_p <- list()
pair_list <- list()


for (i in seq(4)){
  for (j in seq(4)){
    ano <- aov(data = sliced_lists[[i]][[j]], mean~Dec_time + factor(Condition))
    #print(summary(ano))
    
    Tuk <- TukeyHSD(ano, "factor(Condition)")
    #plot(Tuk)
    #print(ap_names[j])
    #print(Tuk)
    
    homo_het_p[[ ap_names[j] ]] <- Tuk[["factor(Condition)"]][10]
    wt_het_p[[ ap_names[j] ]]   <- Tuk[["factor(Condition)"]][11]
    wt_homo_p[[ ap_names[j] ]]  <- Tuk[["factor(Condition)"]][12]
  }

  pair_list[["Homo vs Het"]] <- homo_het_p
  pair_list[["WT vs Het"]] <- wt_het_p
  pair_list[["WT vs Homo"]] <- wt_homo_p
  
  condition_p[[ title_list[i] ]] <- pair_list
}
```

```{r}
# Function to convert a p-value to a significance string
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}

# Apply to the 3-level nested list
condition_stars <- lapply(condition_p, function(level1) {
  lapply(level1, function(level2) {
    lapply(level2, p_to_stars)
  })
})

```
